label: RDMA
description: Remote direct memory access data path for low-latency GPU and storage communication.

label: RoCE
description: RDMA over Converged Ethernet, usually discussed with lossless Ethernet and congestion control.

label: InfiniBand
description: High-performance network fabric commonly used for GPU clusters and HPC systems.

label: Clos Fabric
description: Leaf-spine fabric topology used to scale east-west data center traffic.

label: BGP
description: Routing protocol used in underlays, eBGP fabrics, and data center route control.

label: Congestion Control
description: Mechanisms that prevent fabric overload, queue buildup, and packet loss.

label: NUMA
description: CPU and memory locality model that matters for GPU, NIC, and memory placement.

label: GPUDirect RDMA
description: Direct NIC-to-GPU data path that avoids unnecessary CPU memory staging.

label: NCCL
description: NVIDIA collective communication library used by distributed GPU training.

label: Topology-Aware Scheduling
description: Placement decisions that keep CPUs, memory, NICs, and GPUs close to each other.

label: KV Cache
description: Transformer key-value cache used to avoid recomputing attention state during decoding.

label: Attention
description: Transformer attention mechanism and its MHA, MQA, GQA, RoPE, and FlashAttention variants.

label: Quantization
description: Lower-precision model representation for memory bandwidth and inference efficiency.

label: Parallelism
description: Data, tensor, pipeline, and expert parallel strategies for training or serving models.

label: Checkpointing
description: Model state persistence and recovery path for training systems.

label: MLPerf
description: Benchmark suites for evaluating AI training, inference, and storage systems.
